tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250rgyal ba rgya mtsho lha lnga'i gsol 'debs ni/1$0000300 gnas spyi gtsug pad zla'i gdan steng na// sems dpa' rang byung rdo rje la// bka' brgyud bla ma'i tshogs kyis bskor// bdag mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs// snang srid byin gyis brlab tu gsol// dbus mi 'gyur rdo rje'i gdan steng na// bcom ldan thugs rje chen po la// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor// bdag mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs// snang srid byin gyis brlab tu gsol// g.yas me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na/ khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog la// dpa' bo rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor// bdag mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs// snang srid byin gyis brlab tu gsol// g.yon mkha' spyod dag pa'i gzhal yas na// yum gsang ba ye shes ḍā ki mar// mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor// bdag mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs// snang srid byin gyis brlab tu gsol// steng dag pa lha yi gzhal yas na// slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas la// grub thob rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor// bdag mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs// snang srid byin gyis brlab tu gsol// 'og dam tshig chen po'i gzhal yas na// chos skyong ma mgon lcam dral la// dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor// bdag mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs// snang srid byin gyis brlab tu gsol// rtsa ba brgyud par bcas rnams la// dad cing gus pas gsol btab pas// bdag dang 'gro drug sems can rnams// rnam pa kun mkhyen thob par shog

/sems dpa' rang byung rdo rje ni// yid bzhin nor bu rnyed pa ltar// bdag gzhan yongs kyi dbul ba sel// dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i bkra shis shog /byang chub sems kyi phrin las kyis// thugs rje'i 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro// bco lnga'i zla ba nya rgyas ltar// 'dzam gling bde ba'i bkra shis shog /'dzam gling bde bar mdzad du gsol//
ces grub chen karma pas mdzad pa'o// //
